data.title: 篝之雾枝 · 傲慢女王的沦陷呜咽
data.description: 层叠华丽的哥特长裙被蛮横地堆积到腰际，平日里不可一世的吸血鬼大小姐被反压在书桌上。随着一次次不容抗拒的撞击，她的傲慢彻底碎裂成带着泪光的甜腻哀鸣。
data.location: dim gothic library across massive antique polished mahogany desk covered in books
data.action: bent forward across the desk surface, heavy gothic skirts bunched high, clutching leather blotter as tears of helpless pleasure stream down flushed cheeks
data.lighting: dramatic moonlight pouring through stained glass windows casting vivid violet hues
data.mood: haughty queen conquered, sheer desperate breakdown of pride, intense trembling climax
data.promptProse: Bent over the library desk with lifted gothic dress, Kirie weeps sweet tears of broken pride as overwhelming ecstasy shakes her frame.
data.animaCaption: Kirie pinned across the library desk with hoisted skirts, weeping in helpless pleasure.
